I can't give a confirmed figure for this. Procter & Gamble's fiscal Q4 2026 (April–June 2026) cash flow is only available once the FY2026 10-K is filed, and I don't have that data. The number below is a rough estimate from recalled and extrapolated values, not reported results.

- **Fiscal Q1 2026 (July–September 2025):** I recall operating cash flow of roughly $5.2 billion, though I'm not certain of this.
- **Fiscal Q4 2026:** P&G's 10-Qs report cash flow on a cumulative basis, so Q4 is the full-year figure minus the nine-month figure. Fiscal 2025 implied a Q4 of about $4.8 billion, and I assumed a similar level for fiscal 2026.

On those assumptions, the change from Q1 to Q4 is about (4.8 − 5.2) / 5.2 ≈ −8%.
